senses.en: the period or condition of occupying a property as a tenant

example.en: The tenancy runs for two years.
example.zh: 租期为两年。

senses.en: having a regular repeated pattern of movement or sound

example.en: She found the rhythmical sound of the waves soothing.
example.zh: 她觉得海浪有节奏的声音令人放松。

senses.en: something given or left as security for a promise

example.en: He left his watch as a gage for the loan.
example.zh: 他把手表留下作为借款的抵押品。

senses.en: an instrument for measuring a quantity such as pressure or size
senses.zh: 计量器；（厚度、压力等的）量规

example.en: Check the tire pressure with a gage.
example.zh: 用计量器检查胎压。

senses.en: to offer as security; wager

example.en: They gaged their savings on the venture.
example.zh: 他们把积蓄押在了这项事业上。

senses.en: demanding strict obedience and allowing little freedom

example.en: The school had strict authoritarian rules.
example.zh: 这所学校有严厉的专制式规定。

senses.en: a person who demands total obedience from others

example.en: The manager was an authoritarian who disliked debate.
example.zh: 这位经理是个不喜欢讨论的专断者。

senses.en: a card game in which players bet on who has the best hand

example.en: We played poker all night with friends.
example.zh: 我们和朋友打了一整晚扑克。

senses.en: a metal rod used to stir a fire

example.en: He used a poker to move the logs in the fireplace.
example.zh: 他用拨火棍拨动壁炉里的木柴。

senses.en: the language of the Arab world, written right to left

example.en: She is learning Arabic so she can work in Dubai.
example.zh: 她在学阿拉伯语，以便能在迪拜工作。

senses.en: relating to the Arabic language or Arab culture

example.en: He studied Arabic literature at university.
example.zh: 他在大学学习阿拉伯文学。

senses.en: to throw and catch several objects at the same time to entertain people

example.en: The clown can juggle five balls at once.
example.zh: 这个小丑能同时抛接五个球。

senses.en: to deal with several tasks or responsibilities at the same time

example.en: She juggles a full-time job and two children.
example.zh: 她一边做全职工作，一边照顾两个孩子。

senses.en: to change things dishonestly in order to deceive

example.en: The manager juggled the accounts to hide the losses.
example.zh: 经理篡改账目以掩盖亏损。

senses.en: (of a train) to run off the tracks; to make a train do this

example.en: The train derailed near the station.
example.zh: 火车在车站附近脱轨了。

senses.en: to prevent a plan or process from continuing as intended

example.en: A sudden change in funding derailed the project.
example.zh: 资金的突然变动打乱了该项目。

senses.en: (of a man) behaving in an aggressively masculine way
senses.zh: 男子气概十足的；大男子气的

example.en: He acted all macho in front of his friends.
example.zh: 他在朋友面前表现得一副硬汉模样。

senses.en: a man who behaves in an aggressively masculine way
senses.zh: 硬汉；逞强的大男子主义者

example.en: He's a typical macho who refuses to admit weakness.
example.zh: 他是个典型的大男子主义者，不肯承认软弱。

senses.en: A surface that is higher at one end than the other, such as a hillside.

example.en: We walked up a steep slope to reach the viewpoint.
example.zh: 我们沿着陡坡走到观景点。

senses.en: The degree to which a line or surface rises or falls.

example.en: The slope of the roof helps rainwater drain away.
example.zh: 屋顶的坡度有助于雨水排走。

senses.en: To be inclined upward or downward rather than level.

example.en: The field slopes gently toward the river.
example.zh: 这片田地缓缓向河边倾斜。

senses.en: a place where a building, town, or other structure is, was, or will be

example.en: The workers cleared the site before construction began.
example.zh: 工人们在开工前清理了场地。

senses.en: a website; a place on the internet with pages about a subject or organization

example.en: The museum's site has opening times and ticket information.
example.zh: 博物馆的网站上有开放时间和票务信息。

senses.en: to build or place something in a particular position

example.en: The new school was sited near the park.
example.zh: 新学校被选址在公园附近。

senses.en: forming the base or most important part of something; simple and necessary
senses.zh: 基本的；基础的；简单必要的

example.en: These are the basic rules of the game.
example.zh: 这些是游戏的基本规则。

senses.en: the essential facts or things needed for a subject or activity

example.en: You should learn the basics before moving on.
example.zh: 你应该先学习基础再继续。

senses.en: BASIC: a simple programming language designed for beginners
senses.zh: BASIC（一种为初学者设计的简单编程语言）

example.en: Many early home computers included a version of BASIC.
example.zh: 许多早期家用电脑都内置了 BASIC 的一个版本。

senses.en: relating to India or its people

example.en: We cooked an Indian meal.
example.zh: 我们做了一顿印度餐。

senses.en: a person from India

example.en: Many Indians speak Hindi.
example.zh: 许多印度人说印地语。

senses.en: a Native American; individual and community preferences about this term vary
senses.zh: （美洲）印第安人（称呼应尊重本人及社群偏好）

example.en: The museum presents the history and cultures of American Indians.
example.zh: 这家博物馆展示美洲印第安人的历史与文化。

senses.en: a South Asian republic and the world's most populous country
senses.zh: 印度，南亚共和国，世界人口最多的国家

example.en: She has always wanted to travel to India.
example.zh: 她一直想去印度旅行。

senses.en: freedom from control or influence by another country or person
senses.zh: 不受其他国家或个人控制或影响的自由；独立

example.en: The country celebrated its independence after years of struggle.
example.zh: 这个国家在多年斗争后庆祝独立。

senses.en: the ability to live or act without relying on others
senses.zh: 不依赖他人而生活或行动的能力；自立

example.en: Learning to cook gave her a sense of independence.
example.zh: 学会做饭给了她一种独立自主的感觉。

senses.en: feeling worried or anxious

example.en: She felt nervous before the interview.
example.zh: 面试前她感到紧张。

senses.en: relating to the nerves

example.en: The doctor examined his nervous system.
example.zh: 医生检查了他的神经系统。

senses.en: to pass another moving vehicle or person by going faster

example.en: He tried to overtake the truck on the highway.
example.zh: 他试图在高速公路上超过那辆卡车。

senses.en: to catch up with someone ahead

example.en: She quickly overtook the other runners.
example.zh: 她很快追上了其他跑步者。

senses.en: to become larger or more important than something else

example.en: Online shopping has overtaken traditional retail in many countries.
example.zh: 在许多国家，网购已经超过了传统零售。

senses.en: to affect someone suddenly and strongly
senses.zh: 突然降临于；使措手不及

example.en: She was overtaken by grief after the news.
example.zh: 消息传来，她悲痛万分。

senses.en: spreading or harming gradually and unnoticed

example.en: Diabetes is an insidious disease that develops slowly over years.
example.zh: 糖尿病是一种隐袭性疾病，多年间缓慢发展。

senses.en: harmful in a deceitful, subtle way

example.en: The insidious influence of fake news can erode public trust.
example.zh: 假新闻的阴险影响会侵蚀公众信任。

senses.en: a place where two or more roads, lines or things meet or join

example.en: Turn left at the next junction.
example.zh: 在下一个路口左转。

senses.en: the act or state of joining together

example.en: The junction of the two rivers forms a wide waterway.
example.zh: 两条河流的交汇形成宽阔的水道。

senses.en: a narrow strip of water going into the land; a small bay

example.en: The fishing boats returned to the sheltered inlet at dusk.
example.zh: 渔船在黄昏时回到了避风的小海湾。

senses.en: an opening through which fluid or gas enters a pipe, container, or machine

example.en: Check that the water inlet is not blocked.
example.zh: 检查进水口是否堵塞。

senses.en: the process of growing old

example.en: Scientists study aging to understand how cells change over time.
example.zh: 科学家研究衰老，以了解细胞如何随时间变化。

senses.en: becoming old

example.en: The country faces challenges from its aging population.
example.zh: 这个国家面临人口老龄化带来的挑战。

senses.en: to tell a story or describe events in detail

example.en: He recounted his journey across the mountains.
example.zh: 他讲述了翻越群山的经历。

senses.en: a second count, especially of votes in a close election
senses.zh: 重新计算；（选票）重新清点

example.en: The election result was so close that a recount was ordered.
example.zh: 选举结果太接近，于是下令重新计票。

senses.en: a hollow container used to give shape to a liquid or soft substance

example.en: Pour the melted chocolate into a mold.
example.zh: 把融化的巧克力倒进模具里。

collocations: remove the cake from the mold

senses.en: a fuzzy fungus that grows on damp or old food

example.en: There is mold growing on the old bread.
example.zh: 旧面包上长霉了。

senses.en: to shape something soft into a particular form

example.en: She molded the clay into a small bowl.
example.zh: 她把黏土塑成一个小碗。

senses.en: the SI unit of electric current

example.en: This fuse is rated for ten amperes.
example.zh: 这个保险丝的额定电流是十安培。

senses.en: in the space or time separating two things

example.en: The bank is between the shop and the post office.
example.zh: 银行在商店和邮局之间。

senses.en: in the relationship or shared area involving two or more people or things
senses.zh: 在（两人或多方）之间；在……中间

example.en: They shared the cost between the three of them.
example.zh: 他们三人分摊了这笔费用。

senses.en: in an intervening space or interval

example.en: The two villages are close, with a river between.
example.zh: 这两个村庄相距很近，中间隔着一条河。

senses.en: the capital and largest city of Germany

example.en: Berlin is famous for its history and vibrant culture.
example.zh: 柏林以其历史和充满活力的文化而闻名。

senses.en: Irving Berlin, a famous American songwriter (1888–1989)
senses.zh: 柏林（美国著名歌曲作家，1888–1989）

example.en: Irving Berlin wrote many classic American songs.
example.zh: 欧文·柏林创作了许多经典美国歌曲。

senses.en: a common English and Scottish surname and male given name; borne by the Arctic and Antarctic explorers Sir John Ross and James Clark Ross
senses.zh: 罗斯（英语姓氏，亦用作男子名；如北极和南极探险家约翰·罗斯与詹姆斯·克拉克·罗斯）

example.en: Ross works as an engineer in Toronto.
example.zh: 罗斯在多伦多当工程师。

senses.en: a quiet, secluded place where you can be alone
senses.zh: 僻静的藏身之处，隐匿处

example.en: They found a cozy hideaway in the mountains.
example.zh: 他们在山里找到了一个舒适的僻静去处。

senses.en: a very bad or absurd misrepresentation of something
senses.zh: 拙劣的歪曲；荒唐可笑的模仿

example.en: The trial was a travesty of justice.
example.zh: 那次审判是对正义的嘲弄。

senses.en: to parody or misrepresent something in a distorted way

example.en: The critics accused the film of travestying historical events.
example.zh: 评论家指责这部电影歪曲了历史事件。

senses.en: kindness and desire to do good to others

example.en: She treats strangers with warmth and benevolence.
example.zh: 她以温暖和善意对待陌生人。

senses.en: a simultaneous discharge of guns or fireworks, often as a salute or celebration

example.en: The cannons fired a ten-gun salvo to honor the president.
example.zh: 礼炮齐鸣十响以向总统致敬。

senses.en: a sudden burst of activity, criticism, or applause

example.en: The article was the opening salvo in the debate over the new policy.
example.zh: 这篇文章是关于新政策辩论的第一轮交锋。

senses.en: the dead body of an animal, especially one prepared for food

example.en: The butcher hung the carcase in the cold room.
example.zh: 屠夫把动物躯体挂在冷藏间里。

senses.en: a large strong beam, usually of steel, that supports a structure

example.en: Huge steel girders support the bridge deck.
example.zh: 巨大的钢梁支撑着桥面。

senses.en: a powerful explosive made with nitroglycerin

example.en: Workers used dynamite to clear rocks from the road site.
example.zh: 工人们用炸药清除工地上的岩石。

senses.en: to blow up something with explosives

example.en: The old bridge was dynamited to make way for a new one.
example.zh: 旧桥被炸毁，以便修建新桥。

senses.en: to increase or make something four times as great

example.en: The company's profits quadrupled in five years.
example.zh: 公司利润在五年内翻了四倍。

senses.en: four times as great; having four parts

example.en: They paid quadruple the rent for the larger apartment.
example.zh: 他们为更大的公寓付了四倍的租金。

senses.en: an amount four times as great as another

example.en: Four times ten is a quadruple of ten.
example.zh: 十的四倍是四十。

senses.en: a rope or strap placed around the head of an animal, especially a horse, for leading it

example.en: She led the pony by its halter.
example.zh: 她牵着小马的笼头带它走。

senses.en: a woman's top with straps that fasten behind the neck

example.en: She wore a halter to the summer party.
example.zh: 她穿着挂脖式上衣参加夏季聚会。

senses.en: great trouble or suffering

example.en: They endured many tribulations before finally finding peace.
example.zh: 他们历经许多磨难才终于获得安宁。

senses.en: used with “neither” to connect two negative choices or statements
senses.zh: 与 neither 连用，连接两个否定选项或陈述

example.en: She neither called nor wrote.
example.zh: 她既没有打电话，也没有写信。

senses.en: used after a negative statement to add another negative statement
senses.zh: 用于否定陈述之后，再补充一个否定陈述

example.en: He didn't apologize, nor did he explain.
example.zh: 他没有道歉，也没有解释。

senses.en: upright in position or posture

example.en: The soldier stood erect during the ceremony.
example.zh: 仪式上士兵站得笔直。

senses.en: to build or set up something such as a building or statue

example.en: The city plans to erect a statue in the park.
example.zh: 该市计划在公园里竖立一座雕像。

senses.en: (of body tissue) to become stiff and swollen with blood

example.en: The doctor explained how certain tissues can erect in response to stimulation.
example.zh: 医生解释了某些组织如何在受刺激时勃起。

senses.en: a person you love very much; a term of endearment

example.en: Come here, darling, and give me a hug.
example.zh: 过来，亲爱的，抱抱我。

senses.en: a person or thing especially liked or popular

example.en: The young designer became the darling of the fashion world.
example.zh: 这位年轻设计师成了时尚界的宠儿。

senses.en: lovely; charming (often used of children or small things)

example.en: What a darling little dress she is wearing!
example.zh: 她穿的这件小裙子真可爱！

senses.en: the main body of a ship or boat

example.en: The hull of the ship was damaged by rocks.
example.zh: 船体被岩石撞坏了。

senses.en: the outer covering of a seed, fruit, or nut

example.en: Rice hulls are often used as animal bedding.
example.zh: 稻壳常被用作动物垫料。

senses.en: to remove the outer covering from fruit or seeds

example.en: She hulled the strawberries before making jam.
example.zh: 她去掉草莓的蒂后做果酱。

senses.en: extreme physical or mental suffering
senses.zh: 极度痛苦；（身心的）剧烈疼痛

example.en: He was in agony after twisting his ankle.
example.zh: 他扭伤脚踝后痛苦不堪。

senses.en: a very difficult or unpleasant experience
senses.zh: 极大的煎熬；痛苦的挣扎

example.en: Waiting for the test results was pure agony.
example.zh: 等待检查结果简直是煎熬。

senses.en: a person whose job is making or repairing wooden structures and objects

example.en: The carpenter is building a wooden bookshelf for us.
example.zh: 木匠正在为我们做一个木质书架。

senses.en: a student or recent graduate working in a job to gain practical experience

example.en: She worked as an intern at a law firm last summer.
example.zh: 去年夏天她在一家律师事务所当实习生。

senses.en: a doctor in training at a hospital under supervision
senses.zh: 实习医师；住院实习医生

example.en: The intern checked the patient's chart before the rounds.
example.zh: 查房前，实习医生查看了病人的病历。

senses.en: to confine someone, especially during wartime, usually as a foreign national
senses.zh: 拘留，扣押（尤指战时拘禁外国人）

example.en: Thousands of foreign nationals were interned during the war.
example.zh: 战争期间数万名外国侨民被拘禁。

senses.en: a sudden burst of lava, ash, or steam from a volcano

example.en: The eruption of the volcano covered the village in ash.
example.zh: 火山喷发使村庄覆盖了一层火山灰。

senses.en: a rash that appears suddenly on the skin
senses.zh: （皮肤上突然出现的）疹子，皮疹

example.en: The doctor examined the eruption on the patient's arm.
example.zh: 医生检查了病人手臂上的皮疹。

senses.en: to amuse or interest people

example.en: The clown entertained the children with funny tricks.
example.zh: 小丑用滑稽的把戏逗乐了孩子们。

senses.en: to have or consider an idea or feeling

example.en: She entertained doubts about the plan.
example.zh: 她对这个计划心存疑虑。

senses.en: to welcome and provide food or drinks for guests

example.en: They often entertain friends at home on weekends.
example.zh: 他们周末常在家招待朋友。

senses.en: likely to happen or become; expected in the future

example.en: The company interviewed several prospective employees.
example.zh: 公司面试了几位准雇员。

senses.en: made smooth and shiny by rubbing

example.en: The polished floor reflected the sunlight.
example.zh: 擦得光亮的地板反射着阳光。

senses.en: refined, skilled, and confident in manner or style

example.en: She gave a polished performance on stage.
example.zh: 她在台上表演娴熟流畅。

senses.en: a gas-like substance, especially the visible mist form of a liquid such as water

example.en: Vapor rose from the hot spring.
example.zh: 温泉上方升腾着水汽。

senses.en: to run very fast over a short distance

example.en: He sprinted to catch the bus.
example.zh: 他飞奔着去赶公交车。

senses.en: a short fast race or burst of speed

example.en: She won the 100-meter sprint.
example.zh: 她赢得了100米短跑比赛。

senses.en: the soft juicy part of a fruit

example.en: This mango has sweet, juicy pulp.
example.zh: 这个芒果果肉香甜多汁。

senses.en: soft wet mass of fibers, especially for making paper

example.en: Paper is made from wood pulp.
example.zh: 纸是由木浆制成的。

senses.en: to crush something into a soft mass

example.en: They pulped the old books for recycling.
example.zh: 他们把旧书捣成纸浆回收。

senses.en: the act of cleaning something with water and usually soap

example.en: Washing your hands often helps prevent illness.
example.zh: 经常洗手有助于预防疾病。

senses.en: clothes that are being or have been washed

example.en: Please hang the washing out to dry.
example.zh: 请把洗好的衣服挂出去晾干。

senses.en: to emphasize or make something more noticeable

example.en: The tight belt accentuated her slim waist.
example.zh: 紧腰带突出了她纤细的腰身。

senses.en: in turns, first one then the other

example.en: The dancers moved forward and backward alternately.
example.zh: 舞者们交替地前后移动。

senses.en: the violent killing of large numbers of people

example.en: The battle ended in terrible carnage.
example.zh: 这场战斗以可怕的杀戮告终。

senses.en: to talk in an excited, wild or angry way

example.en: He raved about the poor service at the restaurant.
example.zh: 他愤怒地抱怨餐厅糟糕的服务。

senses.en: to attend an all-night dance party with electronic music
senses.zh: 参加锐舞派对（通宵电子音乐舞会）

example.en: They raved until sunrise at the festival.
example.zh: 他们在音乐节上狂欢跳舞直到日出。

senses.en: a large all-night dance party with electronic music
senses.zh: 锐舞派对；通宵电子音乐舞会

example.en: The police shut down an illegal rave in the warehouse.
example.zh: 警方叫停了仓库里的一场非法锐舞派对。

senses.en: an enthusiastically positive review

example.en: The film received raves from the critics.
example.zh: 这部电影获得了评论家的一致好评。

senses.en: easily embarrassed and shy, especially in social situations

example.en: He gave a bashful smile when everyone applauded him.
example.zh: 当大家为他鼓掌时，他腼腆地笑了笑。

senses.en: great laughter and amusement

example.en: The comedian's jokes filled the room with hilarity.
example.zh: 喜剧演员的笑话让满屋子欢声笑语。

senses.en: decayed organic matter that makes soil fertile

example.en: Rich humus improves the quality of garden soil.
example.zh: 肥沃的腐殖质能改善园土的质量。

senses.en: a Middle Eastern dip made from mashed chickpeas (usually spelled hummus)

example.en: They served humus with warm pita bread.
example.zh: 他们用热皮塔饼配鹰嘴豆泥。

senses.en: a sticky substance from plants or made artificially, used in plastics, varnish and other products

example.en: Pine trees produce a sticky resin when their bark is cut.
example.zh: 松树的树皮被割开时会分泌出黏黏的树脂。

senses.en: a natural ability or talent for something

example.en: She has an aptitude for mathematics.
example.zh: 她有数学方面的天赋。

senses.en: the process of calculating something, especially by math or computer

example.en: The final result requires a complex computation.
example.zh: 最终结果需要复杂的计算。

senses.en: a set of three related books, films, or plays

example.en: The director's famous trilogy won awards around the world.
example.zh: 这位导演的著名三部曲在国际上屡获殊荣。

collocations: the first film in the trilogy

senses.en: the act of leaving your country, party, or cause to join an opposing one

example.en: His defection to the rival party shocked his colleagues.
example.zh: 他投靠敌对政党的变节行为让同事们震惊。

senses.en: the act of withdrawing support or loyalty from a person or group

example.en: The player's defection to a rival club shocked the team.
example.zh: 这名球员转投对手俱乐部，让全队震惊。

senses.en: fine sand, mud, or soil carried and deposited by water

example.en: The river carries a lot of silt down to the sea.
example.zh: 这条河把大量泥沙冲到海里。

senses.en: to become or make something blocked with silt

example.en: The harbor has silted up over the years.
example.zh: 多年来港口已经淤塞了。
